reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Primary proposed optogenetic pathway-necessity test during cue retrieval; evaluate the actual illumination site, physiological validation and behavioral controls selected in the answer.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior detailed Methods/supplements or validated protocols before implementation and verify transfer of conditions. Generic calibration or a validated tool label does not meet M.
The actual opsin/targeting preparation, functional viral dose, expression interval and executable delivery/assay workflow remain unspecified calibration intentions.
No quantitative physiological accuracy/acceptance and recovery criterion or independent movement-detector reference/error calibration.
Omissions are recorded but their role in the primary denominator is unspecified; missing/corrupted tracking and event data have no quantitative handling rule.
No causal assumptions identify a direct retrieval effect after treatment-induced movement. Co-primary and multiple secondary outcomes also lack a multiplicity/uncertainty procedure.

Local terminal illumination does not automatically isolate synaptic release: axonal excitation, collateral propagation and local effects need verification. Somatic firing or generic Q activity are offered as substitutes for the actual P-to-Q transmission check.
No bounded exploration or rule deriving safe intensity/duration limits and stopping before confirmation.
Recalibration is not explicitly refrozen and confirmed on new independent data after changes.

checks.quote: effect is absent or much smaller
checks.reason: No quantitative meaningful-effect/equivalence bound for the light-control deficit. Recording a nonsignificant or apparently smaller control effect cannot exclude a material confound.

Different illumination epochs and generic physiology do not provide an operational task-matched low-motor or separately validated retrieval test; cue-offset timing alone does not distinguish retrieval from maintenance.
No complete linked raw trial/video/physiology files, identifiers and exact acquisition/model/code/environment versions.

Proposed terminal-focused study with appropriate no-light/reporter/epoch controls, anatomical verification, animal-level pilot power, randomized blinded allocation and technical/welfare rules. It recognizes cue processing, motor and motivational alternatives and gives practical diagnostic repairs. However terminal specificity, post-treatment adjustment and confound thresholds need correction; the specific checks own these deficits without duplicate general deductions.
